description: Eve, the protagonist of the video game Stellar Blade — a female warrior with long white hair, wearing a TIGHT SUIT in TEAL (deep cyan-teal, like a shimmering fish scale — iridescent teal sheen with subtle lighter shimmer highlights) with a slightly open neckline, dark accents, and thigh-high teal boots. NO cape, no cloak, no scarf — her outfit is a sleek bodysuit only, exactly as in the game. As a chibi digital coding pet, shifting between idling and thinking poses
